events.title: Día de Los Muertos: Painting / Pintando Calaveras

cases.refreshed: Let's Celebrate Day of the Dead! Stop by the Hillview library and decorate a calavera to celebrate this beautiful tradition. Calavera and painting supplies will be provided. Supplies are limited and available on a first-come, first-served basis. ¡Celebremos el Día de los Muertos! Visita la biblioteca Hillview y decora una calavera para celebrar esta hermosa tradición. Nosotros proporcionaremos las calaveras y los materiales para pintarlas. Los materiales son limitados y estarán disponibles por orden de llegada.

cases.refreshed: With SJPL's Digital Skill Building Pathways, you can practice the skills essential to living and working in the digital world. Learning paths include free lessons, resources, and library events like computer classes. Having trouble following a Digital Skill Building Pathway on your own? Book a 30-minute appointment with a staff member! We can go through a lesson together and answer any questions you might have. Need help with something else tech related? See our One-On-One Tech Help program! #digitalskillbuildingpathways #dsb Digital Skills Free. Advance registration required; drop-ins not available. Please call or stop by the Vineland Branch Library to book a 30-minute session with our staff. Only one 30-minute appointment per day please.

events.title: Milpitas Adult Book Discussion Group - The Lost Journals of Sacajewea by Debra Magpie Earling

cases.refreshed: In November, the Milpitas Library Adult Book Group will be reading The Lost Journals of Sacajewea by Debra Magpie Earling. You are invited to join in the lively discussion. November 18th at 11:00 AM in our program room; November 19th at 7:30 PM In Our Program Room Fiction "A formally inventive, historically eye-opening novel." —New York Times Library copies are available for check out here. The Milpitas Library Book Discussion Group meets on the 4th Wednesday morning and 4th Thursday evening of each month with the exception of November and December, when we will reschedule to accommodate holiday schedules. For adults, ages 18+. We thank the Friends of the Milpitas Library for making this program possible. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3945, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.

cases.refreshed: Join us at Tully library every Thursday for an hour of Tai Chi exercises. Tai Chi improves strength, flexibility, aerobic conditioning, and balance. It's been proven to improve cardiovascular fitness, lower blood pressure, prevent falls, and help people who have arthritis. Free. No registration required.

cases.refreshed: Join us at Tully library every Tuesday for LEGO fun. Bring your creativity and imagination to build unique models using our LEGO pieces. Important: Children under 5 must be accompanied by their parents as small LEGO pieces can be choking hazards. For children and families. No registration required.
